verdicts.summary: Detached fetch fiber is deduplicated, cleaned up on exit, and failures stay swallowed for status reads.
verdicts.scenario: Fetch fails or runs longer than 5s, or two pollers hit the same key. The map entry is deleted in onExit on every exit, and a failure is recorded before the cooldown check at 1280. The cache TTL at 1551-1556 follows the recorded count, so there is no stuck entry or fetch storm.

verdicts.summary: The only hazard is the unbounded Fiber.await before the pull, which finding 0 already states.
